summary: Renders either an img element from src or a container with CSS background styling.
pitfalls: When src is provided, supply meaningful alt text or set decorative with an empty alt value for a decorative image.
Do not pass children when src is provided; children are supported only in background-image container mode.

examples.description: Render an informative img element with meaningful alternative text.
Mark a decorative img element with decorative and an empty alt value.
